# openobserve_group (Data Source)

Reads a group's members and roles. Requires OpenObserve Enterprise.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_group" "sre" {
  name = "sre"
}

output "sre_members" {
  value = data.openobserve_group.sre.users
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name to look up.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{name}`.
- `roles` (Set of String) Custom roles granted to every member.
- `users` (Set of String) Emails of the group's members.
